pin_cites.parenthetical: "hold[ing] that there is no cause of action in Texas for intentional interference with inheritance"

declining to extend the rule of Abor to breach-of-contract cases and explaining that "[t]he 'real' plaintiff in a tort action is the injured party," whereas in a contract case, "each party [usually] claims the other breached"
stating the two-pronged test for mandamus relief
